usedFor: Shopify holds checkouts and customers, and Mobile Text Alerts receives a subscriber through “Create/Update Subscriber”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create/Update Subscriber” in Mobile Text Alerts
bestTemplate.why: An abandoned checkout holds an email or phone, so the shopper can be added as a subscriber.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify is polling, so “Create/Update Subscriber” runs after a scheduled check.
